# Welcome to Discussions

This repository is an open computational study of prime-indexed structure
in Riemann zero spacing statistics.

**What this is:**
- An exploratory numerical experiment
- Empirically consistent with Bogomolny–Keating (1996) predictions
- Open to independent replication and critique

**What this is NOT:**
- A proof of the Riemann Hypothesis
- A confirmed mathematical theorem
- A peer-reviewed result

---

## Discussion Categories

### 🔁 Replication Attempts
Did you run `analyze.py` on your machine? What did you get?
- Same r = 0.6847 (zeros1)? Great — please share your environment.
- Different result? Even better — please document the discrepancy.

Use the **replication_attempt** template.

### 🔬 Alternative Normalization Tests
Tried a different τ_p formula? Share your results.
Normalization sensitivity is the most important open question.

### 📊 Additional Datasets
Tested on zeros at heights other than T ~ 10¹², 10¹³?
Results at T ~ 10²¹ would be particularly valuable.

### 💬 Theoretical Questions
Any ideas about why R(p) varies across datasets?
Any connection to explicit formula terms?

### 🐛 Bugs / Discrepancies
Something in the code or docs is wrong?
Open an Issue using the discrepancy template.

---

## The Most Valuable Contribution

> An independent researcher running `analyze.py` on a different
> machine and obtaining the same r = 0.6847 (zeros1) is more valuable
> than any amount of additional analysis by the original author.

Please share replication attempts — positive or negative.
